chapter.verse: Tu-in hih thute a gen khit ciangin Galilee gam pan Jesu paikhia-in Jordan galkhat Judea gam ah pai hi.
Mihon tampi in amah zui uh a, amah'n zong tua lai-ah amaute damsak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu a zia-et dingin Pharisee-te hong pai uh a, “Mi khat in thu khatpeuh hangin a zi a mak ding phaltheih ahi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “A kipatcil pan amaute pasal leh numei dingin a bawl Piangsakpa' gen,
‘Hih thu hangin pasal in a pa leh a nu nusia-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a, tua nihte sikhat sakhat suak ding uh hi,’ a cih thu, simkha lo na hi uh hiam?
Tua hi a, amau pen nih hi nawnlo-in sikhat sakhat hita uh hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian' gawmkhopsa mite kuamah in khen kei ta hen.”
Tua ciangin Pharisee-te in, “Tua ahihleh bang hangin Moses in makna lai piakna tawh zi ma thei ci-in thupiak hong bawl ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Note na lungtang khauhna uh huhau-in Moses in zi mak ding hong phal hi bek a, a kipatcil pan tua bang nahilo hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah nulepa tatkhialhna thu hang lobuang a zi ma-in midang khat a tenpih peuhpeuh angkawm ahi hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Nungzuite in Jesu' kiangah, “Pasal khat leh a zi kikal thu, tu-a bang ahihleh kiten loh hoihzaw ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Hih thu, mi khempeuh in pom thei kimlo ding a, Pasian' piaktuamte bek in pom zo ding uh hi.
A hang pen pianpihin mi kiget a bangsa omin mite' khut tawh mi kiget a suak zong om a, vantung kumpigam ngaihsutna tawh mi kiget a suaktawm zong om hi. Hih thu a pom zote in pom ta hen.”
Tua ciangin Jesu' khutngak ding leh thungetsak ding deihin naupangte hong kipaipih hi. Nungzuite in tua mite taai uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in, “Naupangte ka kiangah hong paisak un. Amaute khaktan kei un. A hang pen vantung kumpigam i cih, hih bang mite' a ahi hi,” ci hi.
Naupangte' tungah khut a ngak khit ciangin tua lai pan Jesu paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, Jesu' kiangah mi khat hong pai-in, “Sya aw, tawntung nuntakna neih nadingin bang nahoih ka sep kul hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Jesu in, “Bang hangin kei' kiangah bang hoih cih hong dong na hi hiam? A hoih i cih khat bek om hi. Nuntakna sung na lutnop leh thupiaknate zui in,” ci-in dawng hi.
Amah in, “A koi pen teng ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Jesu in, “Tualthat kei in. Angkawm kei in. Gu kei in. Zuau teci pang kei in.
Na pa leh na nu zahtak inla na vengte nangmahmah bangin it in,” ci hi.
Khangnopa in, “Hihte a vekin ka zuihsa hi. Bang ka kisam lai hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “A cingtaak na ut leh pai inla na neihsa teng zuakin mizawngte pia in. Tua hileh vantung ah sumkhuk na nei ding hi. Tua khit teh hong pai inla hong zui in,” ci hi.
Hih thu a zak ciangin khangnopa lungnuam lo-in paikhia hi. A hang pen innlelo tampitak nei ahih man hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah, “Maantak kong cihin ah mihau khat vantung kumpigam a lut ding pen thu haksapi ahi hi.
Khatvei kong cihkikin ah mihau khat Pasian' kumpigam a lut ding sangin kalaoh khat phim bilvang sung a lut ding olzaw hi,” ci hi.
Nungzuite zong hih thu a zak ciangun lamdang sa mahmah uh a, “Tua hi mawk leh hotkhiatna kua'n ngah thei ding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in amaute en kawmin, “Hih pen mihingte' lam pan a piang theilo thu hi a, ahi zongin Pasian' lam pan na khempeuh piang thei hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in, “En dih in, kote in na khempeuh nusia-in nang kong zui uh hi. Tua hi a, kote in bang ka ngah ding uh hiam?” ci-in dong hi.

Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Maantak kong cihin ah khanghun a thak sungah Mihing' Tapa ama' minphatna kumpi-tokhom tungah a tut ciangin kei hong zui note zong kumpi-tokhom sawmlenih tungah tu-in Israel beh sawmlenihte' tungah thukhenin na om ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin keima' min hangin innte, sanggam pasalte, sanggam numeite, pianna pa, pianna nu, tate, leitangte, hihte nusiat a nei khempeuh in a zah zakhat ngahkik ding uh a, tawntung nuntakna zong luah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a masate tampi nunung ding uh a, a nunungte tampi masa ding uh hi.
